<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>FU-01 — Formulario electrónico</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{--red:#a51e2a;--dark:#151515;--bg:#ececec;--line:#d7d7d7}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#222}
.toolbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;height:62px;background:#151515;color:white;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 18px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #0004}
.toolbar h1{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 2px}
.toolbar small{font-size:11px;opacity:.7}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
button.action{border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#shareWhatsApp,#shareEmail{background:#fff;color:#151515}.icon-action{width:42px;height:40px;padding:0!important;font-size:21px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.icon-action:hover{background:#e9e9e9}
.share-status{max-width:936px;margin:6px auto 8px;font-size:11px;color:#666;min-height:14px}
#generate{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
#clear{background:#eee;color:#222}
.wrap{padding:18px}
.note{max-width:936px;margin:0 auto 12px;background:#fff;border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #0001}
.pages{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.page{position:relative;width:min(936px,calc(100vw - 36px));aspect-ratio:936/1321;background:white;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0003;overflow:hidden}
.page>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.field{position:absolute;margin:0;padding:1px 3px;border:1px solid transparent;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);outline:none;border-radius:0;font:13px Arial,sans-serif;color:#111;z-index:3}
.field:focus{border:1px solid #1e6bd6;background:rgba(255,255,255,.65)}
.field::placeholder{color:transparent}
.area{resize:none;line-height:1.1;padding:2px 4px}
.tablefield{font-size:10px;padding:0 2px;z-index:5;pointer-events:auto}.second-tablefield{z-index:5}
.check{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:6;
  width:20px;
  height:20px;
  padding:0;
  margin:0;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:transparent;
  font-size:0;
  line-height:20px;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.check[data-active="1"]{
  color:#111;
  font:bold 15px Arial,sans-serif;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
}
.sig-panel{max-width:936px;margin:0 auto 14px;background:#fff;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #0001}
.sig-panel strong{font-size:12px}
#signature{position:absolute;left:78px;top:704px;width:205px;height:62px;z-index:8;background:transparent;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
.tramite-box{text-align:center;font-size:11px;padding:1px 2px}
.sig-tools{max-width:936px;margin:10px auto 20px;background:#fff;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #0001;font-size:12px}
.sig-tools button{padding:6px 10px;border:0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}

.sig-actions{margin-top:7px;display:flex;gap:7px}
.sig-actions button{padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}
.status{font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-top:7px}
@media(max-width:700px){
.toolbar{height:auto;min-height:62px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px;gap:8px}
.toolbar h1{font-size:14px}
.actions{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
button.action{padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px}
.wrap{padding:8px}
.note{font-size:10px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="toolbar">
  <div><h1>Formulario Unificado FU-01</h1><small>Todos los recuadros del formulario son editables, incluidos los cinco campos de N° del trámite. La firma se realiza en su ubicación original.</small></div>
  <div class="actions"><button class="action" id="clear">Limpiar</button>
<button class="action" id="generate">Generar PDF</button>
<button class="action icon-action" id="shareWhatsApp" title="Compartir por WhatsApp" aria-label="Compartir por WhatsApp">💬</button>
<button class="action icon-action" id="shareEmail" title="Enviar por correo electrónico" aria-label="Enviar por correo electrónico">✉️</button></div>
</div>

<div class="wrap">
<div class="note"><b>Modo de carga:</b> escribí directamente en las casillas del formulario. El diseño visible es la plantilla original; no se reconstruyen los textos ni los bordes.</div>

</div>
</div>

<div class="sig-tools">
  <strong>Firma del solicitante</strong>
  <button id="clearSig">Borrar firma</button>
</div>
</div>
<script>
const PDF_B64 = "";
const PAGE_W=612.12, PAGE_H=864.12;
const S=612.12/936.0;
const state={};
let sigData="";

function fitText(font,text,w,h,max=9){
  let size=Math.min(max,Math.max(4.5,h*.70));
  while(size>4 && font.widthOfTextAtSize(String(text),size)>w-4) size-=.2;
  return size;
}
function pdfY(y,h){return PAGE_H-(y*S)-(h*S)}
function setFieldPositions(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.field').forEach(el=>{
    const x=+el.dataset.x,y=+el.dataset.y,w=+el.dataset.w,h=+el.dataset.h;
    el.style.left=x/936*100+'%';
    el.style.top=y/1321*100+'%';
    el.style.width=w/936*100+'%';
    el.style.height=h/1321*100+'%';
    el.addEventListener('input',()=>state[el.dataset.key]=el.value);
  });
}
setFieldPositions();

function setCheckPositions(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.check').forEach(el=>{
    const x=+el.dataset.x, y=+el.dataset.y;
    el.style.left=x/936*100+'%';
    el.style.top=y/1321*100+'%';
    el.style.width=20/936*100+'%';
    el.style.height=20/1321*100+'%';
  });
}
setCheckPositions();

document.querySelectorAll('.check').forEach(b=>{
  b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const active=b.dataset.active==='1';
    b.dataset.active=active?'0':'1';
    b.textContent=active?'':'X';
  });
});

const sig=document.getElementById('signature'),ctx=sig.getContext('2d');
function resizeSig(){
  const r=sig.getBoundingClientRect(),d=devicePixelRatio||1;
  const old=sig.toDataURL();
  sig.width=Math.round(r.width*d);sig.height=Math.round(r.height*d);
  ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,r.width,r.height);
  ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.strokeStyle='#111';
}
resizeSig();addEventListener('resize',resizeSig);
let drawing=false,last={x:0,y:0};
function sp(e){const r=sig.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}}
sig.onpointerdown=e=>{drawing=true;last=sp(e);sig.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)};
sig.onpointermove=e=>{if(!drawing)return;const p=sp(e);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(last.x,last.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();last=p;sigData=sig.toDataURL('image/png')};
['pointerup','pointercancel'].forEach(n=>sig.addEventListener(n,()=>drawing=false));
clearSig.onclick=()=>{ctx.clearRect(0,0,sig.width,sig.height);sigData=''};

clear.onclick=()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.field').forEach(e=>e.value='');
  Object.keys(state).forEach(k=>delete state[k]);
  document.querySelectorAll('.check').forEach(b=>{b.dataset.active='0';b.textContent='□'});
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,sig.width,sig.height);sigData='';
};

function val(k){return state[k]||document.querySelector('[data-key="'+k+'"]')?.value||''}
async function generate(){
  const {PDFDocument,StandardFonts,rgb}=PDFLib;
  const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(PDF_B64),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
  const doc=await PDFDocument.load(bytes);
  const font=await doc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica);
  const pages=doc.getPages();

  function write(page,el){
    const text=val(el.dataset.key); if(!text)return;
    const x=+el.dataset.x*S, y=+el.dataset.y*S, w=+el.dataset.w*S, h=+el.dataset.h*S;
    const size=fitText(font,text,w,h,9);
    page.drawText(String(text),{x:x+1.5,y:pdfY(+el.dataset.y,+el.dataset.h)+1.5,size,font,color:rgb(0,0,0),maxWidth:w-3});
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.field[data-page="1"]').forEach(el=>write(pages[0],el));
  document.querySelectorAll('.field[data-page="2"]').forEach(el=>write(pages[1],el));

  const checks=document.querySelectorAll('.check');
  const cpos={
    tipoDNI:[190,395],
    tipoLE:[285,395],
    tipoLC:[394,395],
    sexoM:[159,428],
    sexoF:[322,428]
  };
  checks.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.dataset.active!=='1')return;
    const [x,y]=cpos[b.dataset.check];
    page=pages[0];
    page.drawText('X',{x:x*S,y:pdfY(y,20)+2,size:9,font,color:rgb(0,0,0)});
  });

  if(sigData){
    const im=await doc.embedPng(sigData);
    pages[1].drawImage(im,{x:78*S,y:pdfY(704,62),width:205*S,height:62*S});
  }

  const out=await doc.save();
  window.generatedPdfBlob = new Blob([out],{type:'application/pdf'});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(window.generatedPdfBlob);
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='FU-01-completado.pdf';a.click();
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1500);
}
generate.onclick=generate;
function setShareStatus(msg){
  const el=document.getElementById('shareStatus');
  if(el) el.textContent=msg;
}
async function ensurePdf(){
  if(!window.generatedPdfBlob){
    setShareStatus('Generando el PDF...');
    await generate();
  }
  return window.generatedPdfBlob;
}
async function shareFile(app){
  const blob=await ensurePdf();
  if(!blob)return;
  const file=new File([blob],'FU-01-completado.pdf',{type:'application/pdf'});
  if(navigator.share && (!navigator.canShare || navigator.canShare({files:[file]}))){
    try{
      await navigator.share({
        files:[file],
        title:'FU-01 completado',
        text:'Formulario FU-01 completado.'
      });
      setShareStatus('Archivo compartido correctamente.');
      return;
    }catch(e){
      if(e && e.name==='AbortError'){
        setShareStatus('Compartir cancelado.');
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  if(app==='whatsapp'){
    window.open('https://wa.me/?text='+encodeURIComponent('Te envío el formulario FU-01 completado. El PDF fue descargado; adjuntalo en esta conversación.'),'_blank','noopener');
    setShareStatus('WhatsApp fue abierto. Adjuntá el PDF descargado.');
  }else{
    window.location.href='mailto:?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Formulario FU-01 completado')+'&body='+encodeURIComponent('Te envío el formulario FU-01 completado. El PDF fue descargado; adjuntalo a este correo.');
    setShareStatus('Se abrió el correo. Adjuntá el PDF descargado.');
  }
}
document.getElementById('shareWhatsApp').onclick=()=>shareFile('whatsapp');
document.getElementById('shareEmail').onclick=()=>shareFile('email');

</script>
</body>
</html>
